About Me

I'm a Data Analyst with hands-on experience in Excel, SQL, and Power BI, currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at Taiba Higher Institute (Year 3) and training under Egypt's Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI).

I'm comfortable working with data at every stage—from cleaning and transformation to visualization and insight delivery—and I've also gained hands-on IT infrastructure experience through internships in networking and enterprise systems.

What drives me: I love solving business problems with data. There's something satisfying about taking messy data and turning it into clear, actionable insights that help teams make better decisions.
